1. (Currently amended) A system for providing security in a computer system, the system comprising:
a hardware entropy source including a ring oscillator;
a first logic circuit configured to receive a plurality of independent first entropy values from the hardware entropy source;
a second logic circuit configured to apply at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to a permutation function or hash function to generate a second entropy value;
a third logic circuit configured to seed a pseudorandom number generator with the second entropy value and generate a random number using the pseudorandom number generator seeded with the second entropy value; and
a fourth logic circuit configured to produce a block of ciphertext or message authentication code using the random number.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the fourth logic circuit is configured to produce the block of ciphertext or message authentication code with a key composed of or derived from the random number.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the fourth logic circuit is configured to at least:
implement a key-agreement protocol using the random number and in which a key is produced; and
produce the block of ciphertext or message authentication code using the key.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the hardware entropy source is a ring oscillator.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the hardware entropy source is a single hardware entropy source.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the hardware entropy source comprises a plurality of independent hardware entropy sources.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the second logic circuit applies at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to a permutation function.

8. (Currently amended) The system of claim 7, wherein the second logic circuit is configured to:
divide the plurality of independent first entropy values into multiple groups of independent first entropy values;
apply the multiple groups of independent first entropy values to the permutation function to generate permuted groups of entropy values; and
concatenate the permuted groups of entropy values to generate the second entropy value.

9. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the second logic circuit applies at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to a hash function.

10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the second logic circuit applies at least some of the plurality of independent first entropy values to a bit-mixer.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the second logic circuit is configured to selectively apply multiple entropy values of the plurality of independent first entropy values to the function to generate the second entropy value.

12. (Cancelled)

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein producing the block of ciphertext or message authentication code includes at least:

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the hardware entropy source is a ring oscillator.
